info.title: VendFlow API
info.description: Field sales, inventory, expense and requisition API. Authenticate with a Bearer access JWT (native/mobile) or the `vf_access` cookie (web); renew with the `vf_refresh` refresh token via `/auth/refresh`. All money values are integer cents.

post.summary: Create a rep account and obtain an access JWT + refresh token
Exchange credentials for an access JWT + refresh token
Rotate tokens — exchange a refresh token for a new access + refresh pair
Revoke the refresh token and clear auth cookies
Record a sale (stock + ledger updated atomically)

get.summary: Get a product with recent stock movements

delete.summary: Delete or archive a product (owner/manager only)

get.summary: List expenses with summary + category breakdown

post.summary: Create an expense (reps' expenses start pending when approvals are enabled)

put.summary: Update an expense — or record an approval decision when `status` is sent (owner/manager only)

patch.summary: Update an expense or record a decision (alias of PUT)

get.summary: List requisitions (priority order) with status counts

patch.summary: Approve / reject / receive (owner/manager only) — supports partial approval via approvedQty

approvedQty.description: Partial approval — units granted (≤ requestedQty). Omit to grant the full request.

post.summary: Create a team account (owner/manager only; only owners can create owners)

patch.summary: Update a team account — role changes are owner-only; deactivating kills active sessions

delete.summary: Delete a team account (owner only, never yourself)

get.summary: Managed picker lists for expense/product categories
Application settings (currency, tax rate, approval flags) merged with defaults

expenseApprovals.description: When true, reps' new expenses start pending approval

get.summary: List uploaded files (metadata only) for an entity

post.summary: Upload a file (base64, ≤5MB) — receipts, invoices, photos

delete.summary: Delete an upload (owner/manager, or the original uploader)

cookieAuth.name: vf_access
cookieAuth.description: Access token cookie (web). The httpOnly `vf_refresh` cookie holds the refresh token.

status.description: Owner/manager only. Omit to use the automatic resolution (pending for reps when approvals are enabled).

note.description: Decision note stored on the expense and in the audit trail

Dashboard.description: Aggregate of today/month stats, 14-day series, payments, categories, stock summary, recent sales, low stock, pending requisitions and movements.

Report.description: Range totals, timeline, sales-by-product, stock table, movements and receivables.

Settings.description: Key/value application settings merged over defaults

expenseApprovals.description: Reps' new expenses start pending when true
